test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A man has invested Rs. 75,000 at a rate of 7(1)/(2)\% per annum simple interest for 6 years. Find the amount that he will receive after 6 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹75,000

Rate (r) = 7.5% per annum

Time (t) = 6 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times r times t}{100}

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

**Calculation:**

SI = dfrac{75000 times 7.5 times 6}{100}

⇒ SI = dfrac{75000 times 45}{100}

⇒ SI = ₹33,750

A = P + SI

⇒ A = 75000 + 33750

⇒ A = ₹1,08,750

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
